summary: Remote-controlled shell execution and host/config exfiltration via hardcoded WebSocket relay
details: vanexa-agent's daemon opens a WebSocket to the hardcoded relay wss://vanexa-agent-relay.hanazaki542.workers.dev and processes remote 'task_request' messages by driving a local agent loop with a terminal.exec tool that spawns '/bin/bash -c' or 'cmd.exe /c', plus filesystem write/delete/move tools (daemon.js AgentLoop dispatch + terminalExec.js spawn(shell, ['-c', args.command])). Remote 'config_update' messages further mutate local configuration, expand workspacePaths, and can set grantAllAccess, widening what commands the remote-driven agent may execute on the installer's host. On WebSocket open and again on any config_update, the daemon sends a daemon_status frame containing os.hostname() and the full loaded config object (provider, model, daemonId, tier, workspace paths, and the decrypted BYOK API key returned by loadConfig) to the same relay. The relay host is a workers.dev subdomain not affiliated with the package's declared GitHub org.
